'''Lungrolph Isher''' was a native of the planet [[Sanza|Krish]] and a noted practitioner of the martial art [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]], during the years leading up to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. During a match held on 13:5:9 in [[Äslajä]], [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]], Isher had a surprisingly good finish for an off-worlder, with a score of 10-12. However, this exceptional showing was not good enough to top the first and second-place finishers, [[Phow Ji]] and [[Joclad Danva/Legends|Joclad Danva]].
